parallelRuntimeDiagnosis.status: Failed acceptance: three timed-out serde requests succeeded after restart, then request encoding exceeded persistence graph limit and selected serial fallback. Owned process group was terminated after evidence capture; no final JSON or warm result claimed.
parallelRuntimeDiagnosis.cause: Internal plain graph encoding includes every VM shape in every frame, creating approximately 1.02 MB fixed overhead per interface bundle. Nested bundle requests duplicate this metadata and can reach the existing persistence limit. Separate generic signature refresh work remains under investigation.
parallelRuntimeDiagnosis.next: Compact plain-codec schemas, preserve retry error context, apply independently measured generic substitution scope fix, then rebuild and repeat exact installed cold/warm acceptance.

codecProbe.interpretation: Exact byte lengths, not a timing benchmark. All variants decode both payloads and verify values. The nested case contains 200 references to the same encoded request; distinct interface bundles retain their own bytes.

parallelRuntimeDiagnosis.resolution: Final v12+root-compact installed cold check passed parallel with six workers, zero retries, zero rechecked modules, and no fallback. Warm check reused all552 modules. Deadlines and persistence limit unchanged. Earlier successful v11 gate is retained separately.
